name: Adductor Ball Squeeze (Rider Seat)
description: Seated adductor squeeze with a ball — seat and inner-thigh strength for riders.
instructions_excerpt: Sit upright on a chair with a small ball between the knees. Squeeze hard for 5s, relax 2s. 10 reps.

name: Anti-Rotation Pallof Hold
description: Cable / band anti-rotation isometric — braces the core against ski edge forces and snowboard traverse torque.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a band at chest height. Stand sideways to the anchor, press the handle straight out at sternum, arms locked. Hold 20-30 seconds resisting the pull back to the anchor.

name: Banded 90-90 External Rotation
description: Shoulder external rotation at 90° abduction — critical rotator-cuff strength for paddling overhead reach.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a band anchored at shoulder height. Elbow bent 90°, upper arm parallel to floor. Rotate the forearm up against band resistance. Lower slow.

name: Banded ACL Prehab — Terminal Knee Extension
description: Banded terminal-knee-extension — foundational VMO activation and ACL-support drill.
instructions_excerpt: Loop a band around a sturdy post at knee height and behind one knee. Stand facing the anchor with slight knee bend. Extend the knee fully against band resistance, squeezing the quad at lockout. Return with control.

name: Banded Adductor Pulldown (Standing)
description: Standing hip-adduction against a band — targets the adductor complex for cutting and kicking sports.
instructions_excerpt: Loop a band around one ankle with the anchor at hip height to the side. Stand tall with weight on the non-banded leg. Pull the banded leg across the body midline, squeezing adductors. Return slowly.

name: Banded Hip-Flexor Antagonist March
description: Supine band-resisted march — hip-flexor strength in a neutral pelvis; counteracts chronic adductor/quad dominance in team-sport athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Supine with a band looped around both feet, anchored low. Press low back into floor. Bring one knee to 90°, resist on the way back. Alternate legs.

name: Banded Internal Rotation (Shoulder)
description: Internal rotation strengthening — counter to the external rotation prehab; essential for overhead athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Same setup as banded external rotation, but band anchored on the far side of the working arm. Elbow pinned to ribs, rotate the forearm INWARD across the body. Return under control.

name: Banded Neck Lateral Flexion
description: Resisted neck lateral flexion — targeted cervical strengthening for contact-sport athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Loop a band around the head (over the ear) anchored to the side. Lateral-flex the head away from the anchor against band resistance. Return with control.

name: Banded Neck Resistance (Side-to-Side)
description: Standing lateral-neck resistance band work — targets the SCM and scalenes that absorb punch impact and neck-crank force.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a band at head height. Stand sideways so the band pulls your head toward the anchor. Resist by pressing the side of the head into an open palm against the band. 10-15 slow reps each side.

name: Banded Shoulder External Rotation
description: Posterior cuff activation — the shoulder prehab keystone.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with a light band anchored to a post at elbow height. Hold the band in the hand further from the anchor, elbow bent 90° and pinned to your side (you can tuck a towel between elbow and ribs). Rotate the forearm outward, away from the body, keeping the elbow glued to the ribs. Return under contr

name: Banded Shoulder IR/ER Combo
description: Paired internal and external rotation with band — balances the rotator cuff (strikers overuse IR; grapplers compress ER).
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a band at elbow height. Stand side-on with the band in the outside hand, elbow tucked to ribs at 90°. Perform 10 external rotations, then turn around and do 10 internal rotations. Switch sides.

name: Bird Dog
description: Anti-rotation + anti-extension core — quadruped contralateral limb control.
instructions_excerpt: On hands and knees, back flat. Extend opposite arm and leg until both are parallel to the floor. Pause 2s without letting the pelvis rotate. Return. Alternate.

name: Cable External Rotation at 90° (Sleeper)
description: Shoulder external rotation at 90° abduction — the throwing-position cuff-strength exercise used by baseball arm-care programs.
instructions_excerpt: Set cable/band at elbow height. Stand with banded arm abducted 90° (elbow at shoulder height, forearm parallel to floor). Rotate the forearm up and back. Return under control.

name: Clamshell
description: Glute medius activation — prehab for runners, cyclists, and any knee-pain history.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on one side, knees bent 45°, feet stacked. Keeping feet together, open the top knee as far as possible without rotating the pelvis. Close slowly.

name: Copenhagen Hold Short Lever
description: Short-lever Copenhagen plank — regression to the full Copenhagen that progressively loads adductors.
instructions_excerpt: Side plank on forearm with the top knee (not foot) on a bench. Lift the bottom hip off the floor, squeezing the adductor. Hold 15-30 sec per side.

name: Copenhagen Plank
description: Adductor-specific isometric — prehab for groin strain in cyclists, soccer, BJJ.
instructions_excerpt: Set up in a side plank with the TOP leg supported on a bench (foot or inner thigh, depending on level). Bottom leg hangs beneath. Lift the bottom hip off the floor using adductor strength. Hold.

name: Dead Bug
description: Foundational anti-extension core — coordinates contralateral limb patterns.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back with arms extended toward ceiling and knees at 90° over hips. Press low back into the floor. Extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg straight, keeping the low back pressed. Return. Alternate.

name: Eccentric Wrist Extensor Curl
description: Slow eccentric wrist extensions — the evidence-based gold standard for lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow) rehab and prevention.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with forearm supported on a bench, palm down, dumbbell in hand, wrist off the edge. Use the off-hand to assist lifting the weight to full wrist extension. Remove the assist and lower the wrist over 3-5 seconds to a hanging position. Reset and repeat. 15 reps per side.

name: Eccentric Wrist Flexor Curl
description: Slow eccentric wrist flexion — medial epicondylitis (golfer's elbow) rehab analogue.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with forearm supported, palm up, dumbbell in hand, wrist off the bench edge. Use the off-hand to assist curling the wrist up, then lower slowly (3-5s) to full extension. Reset. 15 reps per side.

name: Face Pull with External Rotation
description: Face pull finished with external rotation — the posterior-shoulder and rotator-cuff combo for overhead-sport athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Cable/band at face height. Pull the rope toward the face while externally rotating the forearms up (ending in a W position). Reverse under control.

name: Finger Rubber-Band Spreads
description: Individual-finger extension against a rubber band — targets extrinsic extensors often weak in racquet players.
instructions_excerpt: Loop a rubber band around all five fingertips. Spread fingers apart against the band resistance, then slowly close. 25-40 reps per hand.

name: Forearm Pronation/Supination (Hammer)
description: Controlled forearm rotation with a weighted hammer — builds resilience in the racquet swing's finishing action.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with forearm on bench, wrist off the edge, holding a hammer (or light dumbbell offset) by the end of the handle. Starting neutral, slowly rotate the palm to face up (supinate), then slowly face down (pronate). 10-12 reps per direction per side.

name: Four-Way Neck Isometric
description: Manual-resistance four-way neck isometric — essential prehab for paragliding, hang-gliding, and grappling.
instructions_excerpt: Place a palm against the forehead, side of head, and back of head in sequence. Press the head into the hand without moving for 10 seconds each direction. Breathe.

name: Glute Medius Side Plank Clamshell
description: Side plank with top-leg clamshell — combined lateral core and glute-med endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Forearm side plank, stacked feet. While holding the plank, open the top knee (clamshell) while keeping feet together. Control the return. 8-10 reps per side.

name: Isometric Shoulder External Rotation (Banded)
description: Isometric band-held external rotation — builds the cuff-strength endurance baseball and cricket throwers rely on.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with elbow tucked at 90°. Hold a band pulled across the body, light tension. Resist the band (do not move) for a 20-30s hold. Switch arms.

name: Isometric Wrist Extension Hold
description: Sustained isometric hold at the wrist — pain-modulation tool for acute tennis elbow flares.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with forearm on a bench, palm down, hold a light dumbbell. Lift to ~30° wrist extension and hold for 30-45 seconds. Keep hold stationary. 4-5 reps per side with 30s rest.

name: Lateral Band Walk
description: Glute medius strengthening under locomotion — runner/cyclist prehab staple.
instructions_excerpt: Place a mini-band just above knees (or at ankles for harder). Half-squat, chest up. Step laterally maintaining tension and knee tracking. 10-12 steps per direction.

name: Mini-Band Lateral Shuffle (Disc Golf)
description: Mini-band lateral shuffle — hip abductor activation for disc-golf/topgolf reach & rotate.
instructions_excerpt: Mini-band above the knees. Assume half-squat. Shuffle laterally 10 steps, return. Repeat 3-5 rounds.

name: Neck Extensor Endurance (Prone Hold)
description: Prone neck-extensor endurance hold — hang-gliding and racing-sail postural prehab.
instructions_excerpt: Prone on a mat, hands under chin. Lift head so the cervical spine is neutral. Hold 30-60s without jutting the chin. 3 sets.

name: Neck Harness Flexion Isometric
description: Supine neck flexor isometric hold — builds the deep neck flexors that resist chokes, scrambles, and takedown impact.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine. Tuck chin slightly and lift the head off the floor about one inch. Hold 10-30 seconds with steady breathing. Do NOT crane the chin up — keep it packed.

name: Neck Isometric 4-Way
description: Four-direction isometric neck holds — builds cervical strength for rugby, lacrosse, and collision sports.
instructions_excerpt: Seated or standing. Place hand on forehead, resist as you push head forward (30 sec). Switch to back of head (push back). Then sides (push laterally). All sub-max, no head movement.

name: Neck-Extensor Isometric (Low Bar Position)
description: Cervical extensor iso — prehab for the neck strain specific to long drop-bar sessions.
instructions_excerpt: Face down on a bench, head unsupported, chin neutral. Hold the head in line with the spine for 30-45s. Repeat 3 times.

name: Nordic Curl (Assisted/Regression)
description: Band-assisted Nordic curl — teaches the eccentric hamstring pattern safely for those not yet strong enough for a full Nordic.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel with ankles anchored, band looped around the chest and to a sturdy point overhead/forward for assist. Slowly lower forward, using band to control the last portion. Push back up with hands if needed.

name: Overhead Band Pull-Apart
description: Band pull-apart performed overhead — trains lower trap and posterior cuff in the exact position the tennis serve loads.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a light band overhead with arms straight, hands shoulder-width. Pull the band apart by driving the arms out to the sides while keeping them overhead. Return with control. 12-15 reps.

name: Peroneal Band Eversion
description: Peroneal strengthening — direct prehab for lateral ankle sprains that plague skateboarders and dancers.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with legs extended. Loop a mini-band around the outside of one foot, anchor the other end (chair leg or other foot). Pull the foot outward (eversion) against the band. 15-20 reps per side.

name: Plank with Alt Shoulder Tap
description: Plank with alternating shoulder taps — anti-rotation core for drop-bar riding and handlebar control.
instructions_excerpt: From a push-up plank, slowly tap one shoulder with the opposite hand without rocking the hips. Alternate. 10 per side.

name: Prone Cobra Hold
description: Prone cobra with arms in a low-Y — tonic endurance for the lumbar extensors that surfers rely on during paddling.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone, arms at sides with thumbs up. Lift the chest and arms off the floor, squeezing the mid-back. Hold for time.

name: Prone Snow Angel (Ski Pole Plant)
description: Prone scap and rotator-cuff activation — important for pole plant and ice-axe swing posture.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down, arms out in a T. Sweep hands overhead (Y) and back to hips (I), keeping arms off the floor. Move slowly; squeeze from the mid-back, not the neck.

name: Prone Snow Angel (Y-T-W-L)
description: Scapular control flow — complete posterior shoulder activation.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on the floor with arms overhead. Move through 4 positions: arms overhead (Y), arms out to sides (T), elbows bent 90° (W), arms by hips with palms up (L). Raise each position an inch or two off the floor, hold 2s, lower. 5 reps per position = one round.

name: Prone T Raise
description: Prone horizontal abduction — isolated mid-trap and posterior-delt work to counter racquet-swing internal-rotation bias.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on a bench or floor, arms out to the sides in a T position with thumbs up. Squeeze the shoulder blades and lift arms off the floor to shoulder height. Pause. Lower slowly. 10-12 reps.

name: Prone Y Raise on Incline
description: Prone Y raise from an incline bench — targets lower traps for posterior-shoulder endurance critical to paddlers and surfers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie chest-down on a 30° incline bench. With light DBs, raise arms overhead in a Y shape with thumbs up. Hold 1 sec. Lower slow.

name: Prone Y-T-I Raise (Swim-Specific)
description: Extended version of the Y-T-W routine — adds I (arms fully overhead) for swim-relevant scap pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on a bench or floor with light dumbbells. Perform 8 reps each of: Y (arms at 120°), T (arms at 90°), I (arms fully overhead). Thumbs up; squeeze from the mid-back.

name: Prone Y-T-W-L Complex
description: Lower-trap + rotator-cuff complex — four-position posterior-shoulder builder, the workhorse for overhead sports.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on a bench or floor. In sequence: arms overhead Y, out to sides T, elbows bent W, then L (90°elbow, rotate up). 8-10 of each, moving continuously.

name: Radial Deviation with Hammer
description: Wrist radial deviation under load — trains the abductor pollicis / radial wrist muscles that stabilize during racquet contact.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall, hammer in hand hanging by the side with the head pointing forward. Lift the hammer head up by tilting the wrist toward the thumb side. Lower slowly. 10-12 reps per side.

name: Rider Core Plank with Reach
description: Plank with alternating arm reach — core stability for rein handling under motion.
instructions_excerpt: From a push-up plank, slowly reach one arm forward, return, switch. 8 per side. Keep hips square and level.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
description: Scapular-only pull — builds the foundation of pulling without elbow work.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight, shoulders up by ears (passive hang). Without bending elbows, pull the body up an inch or two by depressing and retracting the shoulder blades. Hold 1-2 seconds. Return.

name: Scapular Push-Up
description: Scap-only push-up — serratus activation in the plank.
instructions_excerpt: Start in a plank with straight arms. Without bending elbows, drop the chest by pinching shoulder blades together; then push the upper back toward the ceiling by protracting the scapulae. Keep the body straight throughout.

name: Scapular Retraction (Prone W)
description: End-range scapular retraction with externally rotated arms.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down with arms bent 90° forming a "W", palms facing forward, thumbs up. Lift the arms off the floor by squeezing the shoulder blades down and back. Hold 2 seconds. Lower.

name: Serratus Wall Push-Up
description: Plus-rep push-up at a wall — activates serratus anterior for scap stability during paddling.
instructions_excerpt: Stand facing a wall in a push-up position. From a normal push-up top, press the shoulder blades further apart (protract). Control the return. 10-15 reps.

name: Serratus Wall Slide
description: Wall slide emphasizing serratus anterior upward rotation — critical scapular control for overhead serve mechanics.
instructions_excerpt: Stand facing a wall with forearms on the wall (elbows and wrists in contact). Press firmly into the wall so the shoulder blades wrap around the ribs. Slide arms up overhead while maintaining wall contact and serratus push. Return. 10-15 reps.

name: Shoulder External Rotation Band
description: Banded external rotation — bow and shotgun shooter rotator-cuff endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a band at elbow height. Grip with the far hand, elbow tucked at 90. Rotate the forearm outward. 12-15 reps per side.

name: Shoulder-Blade Endurance (Y-T-W on Bench)
description: Prone Y-T-W mid-back endurance — classic sailing and gliding prehab.
instructions_excerpt: Prone on a bench with light dumbbells. Perform 8 Ys (arms at 120 deg), 8 Ts (90 deg), 8 Ws (elbows at sides). Thumbs up.

name: Side-Lying External Rotation (DB)
description: Classic cuff exercise with dumbbell — high-yield shoulder prehab.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on your side with the bottom arm under your head for support. Top arm bent 90° at the elbow, tucked against the ribs, holding a light dumbbell (2-8 lbs). Rotate the forearm up and away from the torso. Lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge March
description: Glute-and-core march from a single-leg bridge — unilateral cycling-specific glute activation.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, one foot planted, the other knee lifted. Drive hips up. Alternate knee drives to chest without dropping hips. 8 per side.

name: Single-Leg Land Mechanics (Drop-Stick)
description: Controlled unilateral landing from a low box — reprograms clean single-leg landing, critical for basketball, volleyball, and soccer jumpers.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a 6-12" box on one leg. Step off (do not jump) and land on the same leg. "Stick" the landing — hips back, knee tracks over the middle toe, hold for 2 seconds. Return to box via the opposite leg.

name: Split-Stance Pallof Iso
description: Anti-rotation isometric in a split stance — bulletproof core for the racquet stroke anchor leg.
instructions_excerpt: Set up a band or cable at chest height to the side. Step into a split stance facing perpendicular to the band. Hold the handle at the chest. Extend arms in front of you and hold 20-30 seconds, resisting the band's rotational pull. 3 holds per side per stance.

name: Standing Hip Abduction (Banded)
description: Standing banded hip abduction — functional glute-med loading in a sport-relevant upright posture.
instructions_excerpt: Band around ankles, stand on one leg. Abduct the free leg out to the side against band resistance. Control the return. 12-15 per side.

name: Standing Hip External Rotation (Banded)
description: Banded standing external rotation — glute-med in standing position for carving skaters.
instructions_excerpt: Loop a mini-band above the knees. Stand on one leg with the other knee lifted to 90°. Rotate the lifted knee outward against the band without tipping the pelvis.

name: Tib Raise on Step
description: Elevated tibialis raise — shin-strength insurance for skaters and parkour landings.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with heels on the edge of a step, toes lifted. Slowly lift toes up and then lower them below parallel for a stretched tibialis. 15-20 reps.

name: Tibialis Raise
description: Anterior shin strength — rarely-trained muscle that protects knees and shins in runners.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with heels against a wall or step, toes forward. Lift toes toward the shin as high as possible. Pause. Lower with control.

name: Toe Spread + Foot Doming
description: Intrinsic-foot strength drill — trains the deep foot muscles critical for slacklining, barefoot balance, and foot-arch health.
instructions_excerpt: Seated or standing, plant the foot flat. Try to spread the toes wide apart without lifting the sole. Then, without curling toes, shorten the foot — doming the arch. Hold 5-8 seconds per position.

name: Toe Yoga
description: Intrinsic foot strengthening — runners and standing-desk workers.
instructions_excerpt: Seated or standing. Practice lifting the big toe while keeping the other four down, then the reverse. Repeat each pattern 10 times per foot.

name: Towel Scrunch
description: Toe-flexor endurance drill — scrunching a towel under the foot. Key for foot-intrinsic strength in slacklining and barefoot sports.
instructions_excerpt: Seated, place a small towel on the floor under your foot. Using only the toes, scrunch the towel toward you. 15-25 scrunches per side.

name: Turnout Clam with External Rotation
description: Deep external hip rotation drill for dancers — targets the six deep rotators.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on side, knees stacked and bent at 45°. Squeeze heels together; open the top knee like a clam while lifting the top foot. Hold 2 seconds at top, lower with control.

name: Unloaded Turkish Sit-Up
description: Half of the Turkish get-up — bulletproof rotator cuff and core for paddle and wave sports.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, one arm vertical (empty hand or light load). Same-side knee bent. Roll up to sit balanced on the opposite elbow. Lower with control. 5 per side.

name: Wall Scap Angel
description: Standing wall angel — combined scapular retraction and depression against gravity. A cleaner version of the floor snow angel.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with back, glutes, and head against a wall. Arms up in a W position with backs of hands, wrists, and elbows touching the wall. Slowly slide arms up to Y, then back down to W without losing wall contact. 8-10 reps.

name: Wrist Push-Up (Front)
description: Wrist-strengthening push-up variant that loads wrist flexors through extension — essential fall tolerance.
instructions_excerpt: In quadruped or push-up position, place hands flat with fingers pointing forward. Slowly shift weight forward and back, progressively loading the extended wrist. Start on knees.

name: Wrist Radial-Ulnar Deviation
description: Lateral wrist movement under light load — prehab for repetitive casting, shooting recoil, and archery wrist alignment.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a light dumbbell (or hammer) with the forearm supported. Slowly move the wrist side-to-side through a controlled range. 12-15 reps per direction.

name: Wrist Roller
description: Roll-up of a weight on a cord using wrist flexors and extensors — grip and forearm endurance for long racquet matches.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a wrist roller (bar with a hanging weight on a cord) at arm's length. Roll the bar to wind the cord up, then reverse. 1-2 up/down cycles = one set.

name: Wrist Wrestling Hold (Partner or Band)
description: Isometric wrist/forearm battle against band or partner — trains the wrist rotational strength used in grip fighting.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a band to a post at wrist height, or partner up. Grip the band/partner hand in a thumb-up position. Resist rotation in both directions for 10-15 seconds each. 3-4 bouts per wrist.

name: Zottman Curl
description: Curl up with supinated grip, rotate to pronated for the eccentric — forearm flexor AND extensor strengthening in one rep. Direct UCL and golfer's elbow prehab.
instructions_excerpt: Hold DBs with supinated grip. Curl up. At the top rotate the forearms to pronated (palms face down). Lower slowly (3s) in the pronated position. Rotate back to supinated at the bottom.
